description:
Use this when the user asks who an Indian company's real peers or competitors are and why. For a valuation table of peers use get_peer_comparison.

Returns up to `limit` peers (default 8, at most 15) chosen from reviewed descriptions of what each business does, each with a similarity score, what is shared, what differs, and figures to compare. `purpose` is "operating" (default), "financial" or "valuation". It can return few peers or none when the evidence is thin: it does not fall back to companies that only share an industry label. For a table of ratios across the industry use get_peer_comparison.

event_context.description: Optional note, returned unchanged. It does not affect which peers are chosen.
event_context.title: Event Context

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query

name: get_relevant_peers
title: Relevant peers
